answer: Registration costs 40 POA of compute and 6 hours of uptime, so 1,000 clones need 40,000 POA and a month before the first payout. Attestations from one /24 subnet are taxed 80%, which makes a rack of VMs a hollow revenue stream. Publish the cheapest attack path each epoch beside the summit of the honest-cost curve and raise the bond whenever the ratio drops under 3 to 1. A knoll of 20 agents behind one address nets less than a single honest node.
